name: Slides (L1)
description: Consulting-grade slide drafting: outline planning and editable PPTX export (pptxgenjs baseline). The fast engine of the PPT assistant.
author: LaboFlow

agentTools.name: slides_plan
agentTools.description: Draft a structured slide-deck outline from a topic or source notes. Returns a normalized outline (pages with layout, title, bullets/notes) for user review BEFORE any deck is generated. Input: { topic, audience?, pageCount?, pages? } where pages may carry draft page titles/points from the conversation.

audience.description: Who will see this deck (e.g. client C-suite)

outline.description: Optional pre-drafted outline to normalize instead of drafting

agentTools.name: slides_export
agentTools.description: Export a confirmed outline as an editable .pptx file (PowerPoint/WPS/LibreOffice compatible; every element is a native text box or table). Input: { deckTitle, pages: [{ layout, title, bullets?, data?, quote?, speakerNotes? }], theme? }. Returns the written file path.

fileName.description: Output file name without extension (default: sanitized deckTitle)

font.description: Font family, default PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei stack

title.description: Action title — a full sentence judgment, not a noun phrase

settings.title: Output folder (workspace-relative)
settings.description: Where .pptx files are written inside the workspace
